split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#16
split.text: Hale tells Creel that the old Hydra made them both and has him absorb Gravitonium. When he learns she has lied to him about Talbot, he helps Coulson and Talbot escape her base.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Hydra general who recruits Creel, then lies to him about Talbot.

changes.evidence: At S5#11 "All the Comforts of Home" Hale only recruits Creel for her "team"; Hale's Hydra allegiance is not shown until S5#13-14 (Hydra talk with Werner von Strucker; Qovas "reminds her of her Hydra allegiance"). In S5#16 "Inside Voices" Hale tells Creel they were both created by the old Hydra, has him touch the Gravitonium, and Creel frees Coulson and Talbot after learning she held Talbot.
